balanceHero.label: Shielded balance
balanceHero.ariaScanning: Scanning the chain for this wallet's notes
balanceHero.ariaRebuilding: Rebuilding this wallet's view of the chain
balanceHero.resuming: Opening — resuming from block {{block}}, nothing is lost
balanceHero.keepsGoing: You can close this and come back — it keeps going.
balanceHero.prunedRebuild: This node has pruned old history, so the rebuilt balance may come out a lower bound. Your coins are on-chain — rescan from a node that serves full history to see everything. If this is your own node and it is still filling in shielded history, wait for its log to say "shielded history: VERIFIED" and rescan.
balanceHero.prunedRebuildFrom: This node has pruned old history (available from block {{block}}), so the rebuilt balance may come out a lower bound. Your coins are on-chain — rescan from a node that serves full history to see everything. If this is your own node and it is still filling in shielded history, wait for its log to say "shielded history: VERIFIED" and rescan.
balanceHero.changeFromPayment: {{amount}} ZKAS coming back as change from your payment
balanceHero.changeOwnTx: {{amount}} ZKAS coming back from this wallet's own transaction
balanceHero.arriving: +{{amount}} ZKAS arriving — confirmed, settling into your wallet
balanceHero.sentOnWayMany: {{amount}} ZKAS sent — on its way · {{n}} payments
balanceHero.readyAndArriving: {{spendable}} ready to spend · {{maturing}} arriving — coins become spendable about 10 minutes after they land.
balanceHero.arrivingOnly: {{maturing}} arriving — you can pay once the wallet finishes checking the chain.
balanceHero.scanning: Balances appear as the wallet scans the chain — your funds are safe.
balanceHero.lowerBound: This balance is a lower bound: the wallet's view was rebuilt through a node that has pruned old history, so notes created long ago may be missing from it. Your coins are safe on-chain — rescan only from a node that serves full history (rebuilding through this one would come out just as blind). If this is your own node and it is still filling in shielded history, wait for its log to say "shielded history: VERIFIED" and rescan then.
balanceHero.lowerBoundFrom: This balance is a lower bound: the wallet's view was rebuilt through a node that has pruned old history (available from block {{block}}), so notes created long ago may be missing from it. Your coins are safe on-chain — rescan only from a node that serves full history (rebuilding through this one would come out just as blind). If this is your own node and it is still filling in shielded history, wait for its log to say "shielded history: VERIFIED" and rescan then.

addAccountWallet.noPhrase: This wallet has no recovery phrase, so an account cannot be derived from it. Use “Add separate wallet” — it gets its own recovery phrase, which you must back up.
addAccountWallet.errStore: could not store the account key

seedBackup.quizErr: That does not match. Check your written copy and try again.
seedBackup.legacyWarn: This wallet exists only on this device. No backup, no recovery.
seedBackup.verifyIntro: Pick each word from your written copy.
seedBackup.title: Write down your recovery phrase
seedBackup.warn: These 12 words restore your wallet. Anyone who has them owns the funds.
seedBackup.writeOnPaper: Write them on paper, in order.
seedBackup.alsoFile: Also save an encrypted backup file

recoverWallet.errNotSecret: That doesn't look like a recovery phrase (12 words) or a recovery seed (64 hex characters).
recoverWallet.errWrongSeed: That seed belongs to a different wallet. Check it and try again.
recoverWallet.errStore: This device could not store the wallet key — free up space and try again.
recoverWallet.watchIntro: Shows the balance and history without a recovery phrase. It cannot send: a view key carries no spending authority.
recoverWallet.viewKeyPlaceholder: paste the view key, or the whole link
recoverWallet.errNotViewKey: That is not a view key.
recoverWallet.title: Reconnect your wallet
recoverWallet.nothingLost: Nothing is lost. Your coins are safe on the chain. This browser no longer holds the key for this wallet — browsers clear stored site data (Safari does it after about a week without a visit), and the key was only ever here, never on the server.
recoverWallet.seedPlaceholder: Your recovery phrase, or the seed you saved
recoverWallet.knowWhen: Know roughly when this wallet was created? (much faster)
recoverWallet.wholeChain: Without this the whole chain is scanned. That finds everything, and takes the longest.
recoverWallet.checkedLocally: Checked on this device against the address above, and never sent anywhere.
recoverWallet.justWatch: Just watch this wallet instead (no phrase needed)
recoverWallet.homeScreen: To stop this happening again, add the wallet to your Home Screen — an installed app keeps its storage, a browser tab may not. The installed copy starts empty: enter the phrase there once, and it stays.
recoverWallet.notYours: Not your wallet? Create or import a different one

syncDestination.intro: Your wallet will sync through {{where}}. It sees your balance, your history and where you send — never your keys, and it cannot spend.

onboard.errHasKey: This device already holds a wallet key. Restore that wallet instead — or use the wallet switcher's 'Add another wallet' so nothing is overwritten.
onboard.errStore: This device could not store the wallet key — free up space and try again.
onboard.errChooseBackup: Choose your backup .json file, or paste the backup text.
onboard.restoreIntro: Select the encrypted .json backup you saved, then enter its passphrase. The seed is decrypted on this device — the file and passphrase never leave it.
onboard.errReadBackup: Could not read that backup file.
onboard.errClipboard: Couldn't read the clipboard — paste the backup into the box below instead.
onboard.ifText: if you saved it as text
onboard.restorePlaceholder: or paste the backup here — it starts with {"version"...
onboard.passphrasePlaceholder: the passphrase you set when backing up
onboard.createdWhen: When was this wallet created? (optional — makes sync much faster)
onboard.advancedHeight: Advanced — exact block height (overrides the date)
onboard.heightPlaceholder: 0 = scan whole chain for old funds
onboard.scanHint: Scanning starts just before the date you pick. Leave blank to scan everything.
onboard.errNotViewKey: That is not a view key. Paste the key, or the whole link you were sent.
onboard.watchIntro: Shows a wallet's balance and history on this device. It cannot send: there is no spending key here to sign with.
onboard.viewKeyPlaceholder: paste the view key, or the whole link
onboard.errClipboardWatch: Couldn't read the clipboard — paste it into the box instead.
onboard.viewKeyWarn: A view key reveals every amount and memo that wallet has ever received or sent. Only use one you were given for a wallet you are meant to see.
onboard.welcomeIntro: Create a new wallet, or bring an existing one to this device. Every ZKAS payment is private.
